# Kevin Zhang — Director of IT & Corporate Engineering

- **Relationship:** cross-org; runs corporate IT, identity/SSO, endpoint security, and internal
  tooling. Reports into Operations, not into Maya — a partner, not a report.
- **Cadence:** biweekly sync, alternating Fridays.
- **Where he intersects Maya:** SSO/identity for customer-facing products, employee access
  reviews for [Sentinel](../projects/sentinel.md) (SOC 2 evidence), and laptop/endpoint controls.

## How to work with him
- Reliable and process-oriented; give him lead time and he delivers.
- He owns half the SOC 2 access-control evidence — loop him into Sentinel deadlines early.
- Escalations between eng and IT (e.g. VPN, identity) route through him.
